name: Vankor-Khalmerpayutinskoye Gas Pipeline

values.OtherEnglishNames: Vankor - Khalmerpayutinskoye field gas trunk pipeline; МГП Ванкор - Хальмерпаютинское месторождение

researcher_notes: No roster match (GGIT_gas_snapshot_20260930: no Vankor/Khalmerpayutinskoye/Suzun/Pyakyakhinskoye row by name or endpoints). Built and operating: Rosneft releases state the trunk 'Vankor - Khalmerpayutinskoye field' of 108 km was built for the Vankor gas program (2017 release 185631; 2022 release 198019); commercial gas from Vankor into the UGSS since April 2014 (185631); a 2016 report that construction finished is at sdelanounas.ru/blogs/39953 (Prime-sourced, date unconfirmed, not cited). neftegaz.ru (u3) repeats the Rosneft release so is NOT independent; all cited sources trace to Rosneft, a primary owner source stating the figure, so tier high under single-validated-ref rule, independent=false. Passes add-threshold: sponsor Rosneft (RN-Vankor / Vankorneft operator, no separate entity lookup hit; reuse Rosneft PJSC), endpoints known, built/operating line GEM never captured, length 108 km >= 25 sourced. Not found: diameter, capacity, start year, cost (searched, unverified; leave blank; start year ~2014 inferred from first commercial gas delivery, not stated for the pipe itself). Route: no official GIS found; route creation (Sec. 8) candidate, corridor Vankor field (Krasnoyarsk) to Khalmerpayutinskoye (YaNAO), endpoints need sourced coordinates. Khalmerpayutinskoye end is a Gazprom UGSS interconnection; Messoyakha-Norilsk and Zapolyarnoye-Novy Urengoy are different lines.
